title: Memory of your own
description:
Write in `solution.c`. Every function returns new memory from `malloc` that the caller frees, or `NULL` if `malloc` fails:

```c
char *copy_text(const char *s);                 /* a copy of s */
int *make_range(int start, int count);          /* count ints: start, start + 1, ...; NULL when count <= 0 */
char *repeat(const char *s, int times);         /* s written times times: repeat("ab", 3) is "ababab";
                                                   times 0 gives "" */
char *join_with(const char *a, const char *b, char separator);   /* join_with("ab", "cd", '-') is "ab-cd" */
```

Remember the extra byte for the terminator.
